provenance: Curated from standard software quality specifications, IEEE 830 requirement guidelines, and representative enterprise test engineering standards (authentication, input validation, business logic, security & compliance, error handling, data integrity).
license: Internal TestForge AI Benchmark Dataset / MIT

label_taxonomy.label: authentication
label_taxonomy.description: User login, session management, logout, password resets, tokens, MFA, and account lockouts.

label_taxonomy.label: validation
label_taxonomy.description: Input constraints, field formats, required values, bounds, regex, and data type checks.

label_taxonomy.label: business_logic
label_taxonomy.description: Domain workflows, e-commerce cart/checkout calculations, discounts, inventory, state transitions.

label_taxonomy.label: security
label_taxonomy.description: Role-based access control (RBAC), authorization, encryption, audit logs, XSS/SSRF protections.

label_taxonomy.label: error_handling
label_taxonomy.description: Failure responses, HTTP 4xx/5xx handling, error banners, exception recovery, and graceful degradation.

label_taxonomy.label: data_integrity
label_taxonomy.description: Database consistency, transactions, rollbacks, versioning immutability, unique constraints, and deduplication.

split_strategy: Stratified 70% Train (72 samples), 15% Validation (18 samples), 15% Test (18 samples) with random_seed=42
leakage_controls: Exact duplicate and normalized text deduplication performed before split. Training and testing partitions are strictly isolated.
